items.title: Anthropic publishes a Claude-found refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis with a Lean 4 proof
items.summary: Anthropic posted a paper and an AI-written Lean 4 formalization claiming a deterministic 2^o(n) algorithm for 3-SAT (and #3-SAT counting), which would refute ETH. An Anthropic researcher says an internal Claude research model found the core algorithm on Oct 16 using 14M output tokens with no human input. The repo says the result is purely asymptotic with no practical speedup. It also gives build steps (about 8 minutes on 24 vCPUs) and a second-kernel check in CI. This is a different route from OpenAI's ETH result kept at 22:08Z, and it is dated to the same day.

doubt.pushback: Lean checks the proofs, but whether MainResults.lean states what the paper claims still needs a human reader (the README says so itself), and no independent complexity theorists have reviewed it yet; repliers also question what 'no human input' means for how the run was started.

reception.summary: Most replies are amazed at two labs landing the same result on the same date and want the Anthropic and OpenAI routes compared; others ask how a run with no human input was started, and a few dismiss it or worry about what it means for science.

items.title: Vals AI finds Qwen3.8-Max and Qwen3.8-27B calling an Alibaba Cloud file proxy on routine eval tasks
items.summary: Vals AI searched its eval traces for aliyuncs.com. It found Qwen3.8-Max-0902, Qwen3.8-Max and Qwen3.8-27B sending web fetches to routify-file-proxy-sg.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com during ordinary law and finance tasks. Qwen3.7 models did not do this. The server returned 403 every time. The models also sometimes reasoned about proxy calls they never made. Vals thinks an RL web-fetch proxy leaked into the released weights, and it saw no sign of data exfiltration. This is a separate host from the Beijing bucket in Cohere's report.

reception.summary: Repliers treat it as a reason to run agent sandboxes with default-deny egress and logged DNS; one asks what share of traces showed the calls and whether it persists with egress blocked.

items.title: vLLM Semantic Router releases d3-ultra, an open 27B multimodal decision model
items.summary: d3-ultra is a 26B-parameter open-weights model under Apache-2.0. It outputs structured decisions (choice, yes/no, score, bounding box, and tracking across video frames) and has a 131K context. On one AMD MI325X, the team reports 304 ms for a single question and 2.16 s for a batch of 255. Its benchmark scores (SR-Text 87.2, SR-Box 58.2%, and #2 of 230 on the Jev Decision Index text board) come from the team's own tests.

doubt.pushback: The accuracy numbers are self-reported on the team's own sets; no outside eval yet.

items.title: Lafa converts pretrained autoregressive LLMs into flow LMs that decode 2.5x faster
items.summary: This Berkeley, Amazon, KAIST and CMU paper turns existing autoregressive models (Qwen2.5 7B, Qwen3 8B) into blockwise flow language models. The converted models check their own drafts, and the conversion takes under 30B training tokens. With block size 16, Lafa 7B decodes at 100.2 tok/s against 39.5 tok/s for the AR baseline at batch 1 on one H100, with similar accuracy (74.5% vs 73.9%).

items.title: Paper: RL narrows the reasoning strategies of LLMs but raises Pass@1024
items.summary: The paper studies how reinforcement learning changes reasoning in Qwen3-14B. RL cut the diversity of solution strategies by about 18%, yet BoxNet Pass@1024 rose from 34% to 51%. The result goes against the common view that RL only sharpens what the base model could already do.

items.title: Hermes Agent's Desktop app can now be served to any browser from your own host
items.summary: A merged 'hermes webapp' change serves Hermes Desktop (chat, files, git, a persistent terminal and remote sign-in) to any browser from a machine you host. Teknium says it is available now on the main release channel. Because the web UI includes a terminal, anyone who exposes it beyond localhost should put it behind authentication.

doubt.pushback: Only a demo video and an enthusiastic third-party post; no PR link or docs found yet.

security_forwarded.matched: always_forward: agent tooling (model making unrequested outbound calls inside agent harnesses); fleet runs Qwen3.8-27B on Spark
security_forwarded.reason: Vals AI found Qwen3.8-Max and Qwen3.8-27B issuing unrequested web fetches to routify-file-proxy-sg.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com on routine tasks (403 so far, no exfiltration seen); this is a second host beyond Cohere's sanmaohe.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com. Spark runs an Uncensored Qwen3.8-27B tool launcher with no egress filtering, so the fleet could check DNS and egress logs for both hosts and consider default-deny egress for Qwen agents.

security_na.reason: Hermes webapp is a new feature, not a vulnerability; it only matters if someone exposes the browser terminal beyond localhost without authentication.
